description: This file defines a SwiftUI view component called HomeToolbar, which presents a toolbar UI in a mobile app with buttons for status, chat, talk, and settings. It also includes private subviews for individual buttons, managing visual states and accessibility.

classes.name: HomeToolbar
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that provides a customizable toolbar with status, chat, talk, and settings buttons.

classes.name: HomeToolbarStatusButton
classes.description: A private subview representing the status indicator button with animated pulse effect for connection status.

classes.name: HomeToolbarActionButton
classes.description: A private subview representing action buttons (chat, talk, settings) with visual styling and accessibility labels.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main visual layout of the HomeToolbar view, including the status bar and action buttons.

methods.name: updatePulse
methods.description: Animates the pulse effect on the status indicator based on connection state and scene activity.
